name: Alytus County
adapter_hint: Eurostat NUTS population and median age: python -m scripts.fetch_census.eurostat --level nuts3
religion_note: The religious community a resident said they belonged to, 2011 census, of all residents (Statistics Lithuania, 2011 census). 15 people are in cells the office withholds as confidential, and are counted in 'Other religion'. The 2021 census published religion only for the whole country.
language_note: Mother tongue (gimtoji kalba) from the 2021 census's statistical survey of ethnicity, mother tongue and religion, weighted to all residents; 'Two mother tongues' is the office's own answer (Statistics Lithuania, 2021 census).
population_note: Resident population at the beginning of 2026.
median_age_note: Interpolated within the single year of age that holds the middle person, from Statistics Lithuania's residents by single year of age on 1 January 2026. The office publishes the median in completed years (S3R629_M3010217: 50 here); this is the same median to a tenth of a year, as the rest of the map gives it.
sex_ratio_note: Males per 100 females among residents on 1 January 2026 (61,100 males, 69,530 females).
ethnicity_note: Ethnicity (tautybė) as answered in the 2011 census, of all residents (Statistics Lithuania, 2011 census). The 2021 census published ethnicity below the country only for Vilnius county and for towns and cities, and this unit is neither.
